scene: Scene 04 · Scope Cinemas at CCC · Finale
dialogue: So… this is the mysterious ‘one more stop’?
Scope Cinemas. Okay… what are we watching?
Dinosaurs, puppies, air-conditioning. I’m not seeing a downside.
Cheesecake, pizza, and now a movie. You really did plan the whole thing.
Don’t get used to hearing me say that.
birthday_message: You have genuinely been the best thing to happen to me this year.
I hope this little day — from the strawberries, to the pizza, to the movie, and everything in between — gives you even a tiny piece of the happiness you’ve given me.
There are still a lot more places to go, ridiculous missions to complete, and birthdays ahead of us.
And I hope I get to be your Nick for all of them.
